responsibility: Implements GCC’s core per-function RTL expansion and function-state management. This file owns the global current-function pointer cfun and nested-function context stack, allocates and resets function structures, creates RTL for function-level entities such as parameters, temporaries, and stack slots, and drives stack-frame bookkeeping, prologue/epilogue-related state, and assorted helpers used during expansion from trees/GIMPLE into RTL. It also defines function-oriented backend utilities and RTL passes such as asm operand constraint matching, which rewrites matching inline-asm inputs/outputs into forms reload can satisfy. In short, this is the main implementation file behind function.h’s per-function data structures and the transition into backend function representation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the per-function RTL and function-context services declared in gcc/function.h, including ownership of cfun, nested-function context push/pop, stack-slot and frame management, expansion support, and related RTL passes; unlike the header, it contains the operational code behind those interfaces and data structures.
